title: Senior Data Engineer São Paulo
description:
We're looking for a talented and passionate Senior Data Engineer to join Wildlife's Marketing Tech team in São Paulo, Brazil.

Wildlife is one of the largest gaming companies in the world. Besides building amazing games, part of the reason it has been super successful has been its ability to acquire new users more efficiently than other companies. As a Senior Data Engineer, you'll play a key role in our Performance Marketing operations by handling data from millions of users, thousands of campaigns, and dozens of different channels, helping us to solve our most challenging quests. Some of them are:

  • Evolve integrations with several third-party APIs including Ad Networks, MMPs, and other data providers
  • Attribute the users to the marketing campaigns that drove their financial impact;
  • Estimate the lifetime value of our users to measure the long-term return on our Marketing investments;
  • Build the capabilities to run experiments to continuously improve the performance of our creative assets and our Marketing operations;
  • Support the decision-making of our Marketing operations through high-quality data products and well-structured dashboards;

We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company's success and culture. The right person for this position is naturally curious, comfortable in a "take the initiative" environment, loves solving problems, is resilient, and can thrive in a fast and growing business.

What you'll do

  • Solve complex and open-ended problems that directly impact one of the most critical areas of the company;
  • Help to evolve and improve the performance of our current solutions and build new data products and systems
  • Be part of a cross-functional team, directly contributing end-to-end to our processes, making sure our products are in production and working properly (final impact);
  • Work in a challenging and fun environment to produce exceptional results.

What you'll need

  • Experience working on designing and developing data-intensive applications in the cloud with technologies such as Spark, SQL, Python, Airflow, etc
  • Excellent high-level communication skills
  • Proficiency in written English
  • The team is responsible for designing, building, and evolving a big set of complex data-intensive applications including batch data apps, near real-time data ingestion, ML models, and BI pipelines
  • These applications also require the team to build, maintain, and evolve integrations with several third-party APIs including Ad Networks, MMPs, and other data providers used in Digital Marketing
  • As a Senior Data Engineer, you will help the team to ensure high availability, reliability, robustness, performance, cost-effectiveness, and maintainability of the developed solutions
  • We have a multidisciplinary environment and you will interact with people from diverse backgrounds, including Game Engineers, Backend Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Marketing Managers.

More about you

  • You are impact-driven and interested in learning more about adjacent disciplines (e.g.: Backend, Data Science, etc);
  • You like to solve open-ended problems with non-obvious solutions;
  • You communicate in a structured way both speaking and writing, including in English;
  • You are an excellent teammate and raise the bar of those around you.

About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the world's leading mobile game developers and publishers. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

Wildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.

title: Senior GRC Analyst
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Area

The Engineering team at Tractian is at the forefront of developing cutting-edge infrastructure, technologies, and products to harness the power of IoT data. Our team of talented Engineers collaborates to build robust systems, innovative solutions, and scalable platforms that drive Tractian's success. We are instrumental in shaping the company's decision-making process, optimizing operational efficiency, and delivering exceptional experiences to our consumers.

What you will do

As a GRC Analyst, you will be responsible for developing and implementing robust governance, risk management, and compliance (GRC) practices within our technology-driven organization. You will play a key role in establishing frameworks and processes that ensure the security, integrity, and regulatory compliance of our technology systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess risks, implement controls, and drive continuous improvement of our GRC program.

Responsibilities

  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Perform Business Impact Analysis (BIA), mapping processes and identifying RTO and RPO.
  • Conduct the identification, mapping, assessment, and management of both operational and strategic risks across the organization, ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations and internal policies.
  • Keep all the BCP and Disaster Recovery documents up to date.
  • Develop, implement, and update company-wide compliance processes, procedures and rules to ensure alignment with corporate goals, legal requirements, and industry standards.
  • Collaborate with other departments to create and modify operational processes and agreements and execute actions from action plans.
  • Conduct and document regular tests for recovery, continuity plans (disaster recovery exercise, backup & data recovery, etc.) also supporting incident response tests.
  • Implement privacy controls following the company’s governance guidelines and LGPD, GDPR, and CCPA regulations.
  • Support the continuous improvement of compliance with ISO 27001, 27002, 22301 and 22313 standards.
  • Monitor and conduct assessments to ensure the effectiveness of internal controls, also implementing improvements considering audits and assessments reports.
  • Collaborate with multiple departments and headquarters to ensure effective implementation of compliance programs and provide guidance on risk-related matters to leadership.
  • Collaborate to clarify security maturity doubts with stakeholders.
,

Requirements:

  • Background in IT, security, auditing, compliance and/or quality.
  • Experience with BCP-DR based on ISO 22301 and ISO 22313, including development of procedures, execution, and documentation of tests.
  • Experience with audits and assessments of ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
  • Hands-on experience in executing action plans and implementing controls.
  • Knowledge with risk management frameworks (ISO 27005, NIST etc.).
  • Knowledge of privacy laws (LGPD, CCPA, GDPR, etc.)
  • Advanced English proficiency.
,

Would be a plus:

  • Certification related to ISO 27001 and/or privacy (e.g., EXIN or IAPP).
  • Experience in using Business Continuity Management (BCM) tools.
  • Experiences with Vanta, SAT platforms, EDR, MDM, IAM.
  • Other compliance/security certifications.
Compensation:
  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Employee Giving
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Day off during the week of your birthday
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

title: Head of Public Policy, Latin America
description:
Discord is used by over 200 million people every month for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does on our platform: play video games. Over 90% of our users play games, spending a combined 1.5 billion hours playing thousands of unique titles on Discord each month. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to talk and hang out before, during, and after playing games.

As Discord’s Head of Public Policy for Brazil and Latin America, you will be responsible for building trust and finding common ground with policymakers, regulators, and other stakeholders in Brasilia and national capitals across Latin America. This role can be resident in Sao Paulo or Brasilia and will report to the Head of Americas Public Policy.

What you will do

  1. Introduce Discord to government policymakers and civil society stakeholders in key markets across the region, including educating decision-makers on our founding vision, our products, and our investments in privacy and safety;
  2. Develop and execute a multi-year government advocacy strategy that maps the interests of Discord users and the company’s business goals to the evolving legal and regulatory landscape in those key markets;
  3. Identify emerging trends in the regulation of online communications services and build action plans responsive to these trends in coordination with our Legal, Product, and Communications teams;
  4. Advocate for Discord’s position on key legislative and regulatory initiatives that will impact our users and our business, balancing direct advocacy with effective leverage from coalitions and associations;
  5. Provide context and support for the company’s responses to regulator inquiries;
  6. Promote employee awareness and invite employee engagement on our public policy strategy and priorities;
  7. Engage in public policy coalitions with peer companies and civil society organizations;
  8. Coordinate and drive compelling returns from the company’s partnerships with non-profits and civil society organizations;
  9. Manage the company’s government affairs consultants and advisors in Latin America.

What you should have

  1. Sustained (7+ years) professional success at the highest levels of government and/or in strategic public policy advocacy
  2. Experience developing and executing public policy advocacy campaigns in Brazil, with experience in other key markets (Mexico, Argentina, Chile) in the region a plus
  3. Insight on the policymaking process in key markets throughout the region
  4. Commitment to Discord’s mission to be the place where everyone can find belonging before, during and after playing games together online
  5. Willingness to travel as necessary within the region, with occasional travel to the U.S. as required

Bonus Points

  1. Work experience on technology policy initiatives such as online safety, privacy, cybersecurity, or content moderation, especially in the online gaming space
  2. Ability to translate complex technical information into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical audiences
  3. Leadership experience with a civil society organization and/or tech company
  4. Success building trust and consensus across stakeholders with different perspectives and priorities

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join oursustainable business practicesfocused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

title: Backend Engineer - Game Security
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ECOSEC

What We Do

Our ECOSEC team provides a safer experience for Epic's users. We work across multiple products and services to improve technology and craft transparent policies so our players and users can have positive experiences on our platforms.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Backend Security Engineer focused on Asset Integrity to protect sensitive game assets from unintended information disclosure. Your efforts will be critical to the success of Fortnite and the many creators who depend on it. The ideal candidate will be well-versed in backend development and have prior experience developing security features. This is an incredible opportunity to contribute to the next generation of Epic’s game development tools.

In this role, you will

  • Directly contribute code and be a code owner for multiple services and code bases
  • Collaborate with the Fortnite, Unreal Engine, and Epic Games Store teams to understand the security implications of existing and upcoming features, proposing changes if appropriate
  • Work with internal and external UEFN development teams, including well-known brands, to address concerns about asset integrity and information disclosure
  • Investigate technical root causes of unintended information disclosure incidents
  • Proactively seek out components in Fortnite backend services that create asset integrity risks, then clearly communicate the problem and recommended solution
  • Build and improve internal tooling at scale to protect the Epic creator ecosystem
  • Handle various real-time issues that may arise on online services and platforms

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, with experience in backend development for games
  • Expert knowledge in one or more of the following programming languages: C++, Java, Go, or TypeScript
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems and design patterns
  • Strong knowledge of AWS/Cloud infrastructure including code-as-infrastructure (e.g. Terraform)
  • Experience building & managing distributed systems, designing APIs, and deploying services (e.g. Kubernetes)
  • Experience working with data analytics to solve, prevent, or monitor for problems
  • Knowledge and/or experience mitigating security vulnerabilities in sandboxes / virtual machines and potential mitigation strategies
  • Experience building or working with CI/CD environments
  • Experience working with building and deploying container images

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

title: Remote Site Engineer (IP/Network)
description:
Join to apply for the Remote Site Engineer (IP/Network) role at Speedcast

Join to apply for the Remote Site Engineer (IP/Network) role at Speedcast

Overview Of Position
The Sr. IP Network Engineer is an individual contributor with advanced background in IP Network Engineering design, implementation and operation.

Overview Of Position
The Sr. IP Network Engineer is an individual contributor with advanced background in IP Network Engineering design, implementation and operation.
The primary objective of the Sr. IP Engineer within the Edge Network Engineering team is to properly identify customer requirements and establish and deploy a solution which meets the customer’s needs and expectations. This will require disciplined compliance with change management best practices while working both independently and with cross-functional teams; this role will have opportunities to coach team members on complex technical issues, interface with other engineering and support groups internally, and engage with customer IT personnel on complex network/system performance and troubleshooting efforts.
This Sr. IP engineer position provides customer facing global IP network design and implementation, hardware selection and configuration standardization as it relates to network routing protocol, switching and security methodology. As part of the Edge Network Engineering team, the role also includes Tier 4 escalations from the global support organization as well as providing pre-sales technical consultation alongside Sales and Solutions/Systems Engineering teams.
What you will do:

  • Build and maintain customer’s IP network infrastructure within Speedcast Edge network
  • Enforcing Cyber Security policies and hardening of non-core managed network devices
  • Contributes to the development of customer-facing solutions in coordination with Sales/Sales Engineering, Product/Edge Network Engineering teams to ensure optimal solution and supportability
  • Ensure that all engineering parameters and configurations meet the client’s requirements and are being fulfilled on a timely basis
  • Provide 4th level technical escalation support by providing end-to-end subject matter expertise
  • Design and implement customer functional networks such as LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, QoS, and Security/VPN
  • Collaborate with other Engineers around the globe in the design and deployment of new services and/or enhancements/changes to existing network services
  • Advise and recommend technical solutions that will enhance, increase levels of redundancy, survivability and add flexibility to existing global Speedcast systems, network and VSAT Platforms
  • Coach and mentor team members on complex technical issues to deliver the highest level of service to our customers
  • Assist in strengthening IP expertise within the Edge Network Engineering and Customer Support Teams
  • Assist in the development or improvements of network operational best practices and processes to customer network performance, capacity and scalability
  • Ensures that appropriate action is taken to anticipate, investigate and resolve problems in systems and services. Coordinates the implementation of agreed remedies and preventative measures. Analyzes patterns and trends
  • Controls, updates and distributes new and revised quality, configuration and services standards, including technical changes, and maintains documentation
What we need from you:
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (BSEE preferred) but will consider candidates with the right combination of relevant work experience or degrees in related fields
  • Must have at least 7 years of network engineering design and operation experience utilizing various networking equipment from Cisco, Palo Alto, Versa Networks, Juniper
  • Must have proven experience in the application of network design, development and implementation techniques in communications systems that involve a variety of hardware and software suites
  • End-to-end knowledge of various access technologies and networking protocols.
  • CCIE certification preferred but may be substituted with equivalent experience and knowledge of routing, switching and Security/VPN
  • Advanced level knowledge and hands on working experience of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, RIPv2), MPLS and SD-WAN
  • Advanced level knowledge and hands on working experience in designing and implementing complex QoS in a Cisco network environment.
  • Extensive experience with Network Security and VPN design and implementation utilizing Cisco and Palo Alto
  • Extensive experience with WAN optimization technology platforms
  • Experience with Newtec Dialog and iDirect VSAT Platform is a plus.
  • Experience with various VSAT antenna systems such as Seatel, Cobham, Intellian, Sailor, Virgin Technologies, Orbit and Kymeta is a plus
  • Experience with various wireless broadband in offshore communication such as LTE, Inmarsat FleetBroadband/BGAN, Iridium
  • Experience with various NMS and ITSM such as Solarwinds, DataMiner and ServiceNow
  • Experience with network packet analyzer tools such as Wireshark, NetFlow or equivalent and bandwidth measurement tool such iPerf or equivalent tool
  • Able to communicate effectively via written and verbal communications.
  • Excellent problem solver, flexible and able to accommodate changing priorities and directions
  • Must be able to interact effectively within all levels of the company
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and function with minimal supervision
  • Research and analytical skills with the ability to collect access and report factual data and present logical conclusions

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Oprojeto Acolhidos por meio do trabalho promove a integração de pessoas refugiadas e migrantes venezuelanas por meio de ações de qualificação, empregabilidade e articulação com o setor privado. Santa Catarina é o estado que mais recebe famílias interiorizadas e concentra a maior parte das parcerias com empresas no Brasil. Esse ecossistema local de acolhimento é dinâmico, mas demanda uma articulação mais estruturada para garantir o sucesso da integração.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O(a) Oficial de Operações é responsável por apoiar na coordenação da estratégia de interiorização, assegurando o acolhimento adequado dos migrantes e refugiados venezuelanos nas cidades de destino e promovendo sua integração socioeconômica. Atua diretamente na supervisão de serviços de apoio psicossocial, organização logística, elaboração de documentos e monitoramento das ações nos territórios que recebem venezuelanos interiorizados.

Apoio à estratégia de interiorização:

Apoiar a Coordenação no processo de interiorização, reunindo e organizando todas as informações e ações necessárias para garantir o bom recebimento e acompanhamento das famílias interiorizadas.

Articular com a Coordenação do projeto em Boa Vista as etapas prévias e posteriores à interiorização dos beneficiários.

Logística e suporte às famílias interiorizadas:

Elaborar pedidos de requisição de mobiliários, cestas básicas, kits de higiene e outros insumos, conforme a composição familiar e as necessidades identificadas em campo.

Organizar e acompanhar a chegada dos beneficiários nas cidades de acolhida, assegurando a entrega de itens essenciais e o suporte necessário à instalação das famílias.

Gestão do suporte psicossocial:

Identificar, entrevistar e selecionar consultores psicossociais locais que apoiarão os beneficiários por períodos de 3 a 4 meses.

Acompanhar a atuação desses profissionais e garantir a entrega de relatórios de acompanhamento conforme os padrões acordados.

Monitorar vigência de contratos e apoiar nos trâmites administrativos relacionados ao pagamento das consultorias.

Monitoramento e produção de informações:

Realizar visitas de monitoramento para acompanhar o processo de integração dos beneficiários nas cidades de destino.

Apoiar a coleta e sistematização de dados sobre os beneficiários interiorizados, contribuindo para o monitoramento de indicadores do projeto.

Elaborar relatórios técnicos, descritivos e de acompanhamento das ações realizadas no território.

Apoiar na elaboração, revisão e organização de contratos de prestação de serviço, termos de referência, pedidos de compras e outros documentos administrativos relacionados às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.

Manter a organização e atualização dos arquivos e documentos físicos e digitais de sua área.

Contribuir para a prestação de contas e sistematização de boas práticas junto à equipe local e nacional.

  • Client Satisfaction: Positive feedback and relationship strength with client accounts.

  • Reports directly to the Account Manager.

Compensation Structure
  • The compensation philosophy ensures competitive pay aligned with performance, proficiency, and company affordability. Compensation is reviewed annually based on market benchmarks and individual contributions.

Open position: Senior Software Developer (Backend)

Join us, and let’s create a safer, more connected world together!

About the Opportunity:

Modirum | Gespi is adapting its proven technologies for the dynamic UAV Defence sector through a dedicated new development team. We are seeking experienced Senior Backend Software Developers to design, build, and maintain the scalable, secure, and reliable server-side systems that underpin our innovative defence solutions. You will tackle complex technical challenges and contribute significantly to the core functionality of our products.

Your Role in the Team:

As a Senior Backend Developer, you are a cornerstone of the team responsible for building the engine of our defence applications. You will:

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain robust backend services, APIs, and data persistence layers.
  • Write clean, efficient, well-documented, and testable code in languages like Java, Kotlin, Python, or Node.js.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and the evolution of the backend systems.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers, AI specialists, hardware engineers, and the product team to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Optimize applications for maximum speed, scalability, and reliability.
  • Implement security and data protection best practices crucial for the defence sector.
  • Mentor junior developers and participate actively in code reviews, promoting high standards.
  • Troubleshoot and debug complex backend issues, ensuring system stability.
  • Play a key role in the team’s output by delivering high-quality backend features and infrastructure components.

Qualifications:

As a Senior Backend Developer, you are a cornerstone of the team responsible for building the engine of our defence applications. You will:

  • Proven experience as a Senior Software Developer focused on backend systems.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more backend programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js).
  • Solid experience designing and building RESTful APIs or other service communication protocols (e.g., gRPC).
  • Experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • Understanding of software design patterns, microservices architecture, and distributed systems concepts.
  • Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience building systems for Defence, Aerospace, or other high-security/high-reliability domains.
  • Experience with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) or event-driven architectures.
  • Knowledge of performance tuning and optimization techniques.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation tools.
  • Contribution to open-source projects

What We Offer:

  • The opportunity to build critical backend systems for the high-impact UAV Defence sector.
  • A senior technical role within a new team adapting proven technology for a challenging market.
  • Work on complex backend problems related to scale, security, and data processing.
  • Collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team of experts.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • A culture that values technical depth and collaboration.

title: Gerente de Estratégia Comercial
description:
A Daki nasceu para revolucionar o delivery de mercado. O que antes alguém recebia em horas ou dias, agora recebe em minutos!
Mais que entregar rápido, buscamos entregar uma experiência incrível para os nossos clientes. Buscamos aquele "UAU" de quando o cliente recebe muito antes do que esperava.
E tudo começa muito antes da montagem do pedido, na verdade, começa bem aqui.
Estamos à procura de um Gerente de Estratégia Comercial para se juntar ao nosso time e assumir responsabilidades estratégicas e táticas essenciais para o crescimento e sucesso de nossas categorias de produtos. A pessoa ideal possuirá habilidades analíticas robustas, além de uma excelente capacidade de gestão de processos e dados.
O que você fará:
Desenvolver e implementar a estratégia de categorias, de acordo com a estrutura e o papel de cada categoria (destino, conveniência, rotina, etc.).
Elaborar estratégias específicas para vendas, margem, escoamento e outras métricas de desempenho.
Definir a estratégia de sortimento com base em benchmarks da indústria, determinando o tamanho ideal do sortimento e fazendo recomendações sobre ativação e inativação de SKUs.
Analisar a profundidade e diversificação de produtos por categoria, garantindo um mix de produtos competitivo e alinhado com as necessidades do mercado.
Suportar o time comercial na execução de processos diários, assegurando eficiência e eficácia nas operações.
Manter a acurácia dos dados disponíveis, implementando procedimentos para a sua verificação e atualização regular.
Buscar melhorias na experiência do consumidor e auxiliar no desenvolvimento junto aos times de Produto.
Liderar e desenvolver uma equipe, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e de alto desempenho.
O que você precisa
Sólida experiência em funções similares de gestão comercial ou consultoria estratégica.
Fortes habilidades analíticas e capacidade de traduzir dados em insights acionáveis.
Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de análise de dados e visualização (Excel, Sheets, SQL, Python, etc.).
Habilidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes multifuncionais e em diferentes regiões.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita em português e inglês.
Capacidade de desenvolver, questionar e implementar estratégias comerciais que impulsionem o crescimento e a rentabilidade.
Experiência prévia em gerenciamento de sortimento e manutenção de bases de dados de produtos é um diferencial.
Informações adicionais:
Estamos em crescimento: Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido, permitindo que o Dakier atue de forma remota e presencial;
Somos Modernos: por meio de um cartão de crédito da bandeira Mastercard, você recebe o vale refeição, dando mais liberdade ao Dakier de como utilizar;
Transporte: realizamos o depósito direto no VT de acordo com a necessidade de passagem do Dakier até a unidade;
Saúde: Hoje disponibilizamos para o nosso Dakier a Assistência Médica e Odontológica, e também o Total Pass;
Mimo: Nossos Dakier tem desconto de 10% em todas as compras feitas em nosso do APP.

Sobre a Daki:
Poucas indústrias passaram por uma revolução tão grande na pandemia da COVID-19 como a do delivery de supermercado. Ao mesmo tempo que muitas empresas consolidadas cresceram ainda mais nesse período, elas ainda não conseguiam entregar uma boa experiência para seus clientes.
E nós sabíamos que o cliente merecia mais. Por isso, resolvemos desenvolver um modelo do zero, com foco total nas pessoas e com a ambição de uma startup que busca a liderança de mercado!
Aí criamos a Daki. :)
Somos o app de delivery mais rápido do Brasil. Entregamos mais de 1000 produtos na sua porta em minutos! Simples, intuitivo e super rápido - para você ter tempo de desfrutar o melhor da sua vida sem precisar perder tempo indo ao supermercado.
Nossos produtos foram cuidadosamente selecionados para atender aos prazeres do dia-a-dia e também às necessidades de uma vida agitada. Temos da cerveja gelada ao carregador de celular, e estamos sempre à procura de inovações que entreguem experiências ainda melhores para a nossa exigente clientela.
Estamos em busca de pessoas que compartilhem essa visão de um mundo mais simples, tecnológico e com foco no cliente, e também que transbordem energia para tirar esse sonho do papel. Se você se identificou, esse é um bom sinal!

Nossos valores:
Na Daki, acreditamos que é possível revolucionar o mercado sem abrir mão do que é mais importante: as pessoas.
Cuidar de você e do outro é essencial para manter um ambiente de trabalho leve, onde todos se sintam seguros, física e psicologicamente.
Colaborar é a chave para o sucesso. Estamos sempre atentos às necessidades e objetivos de todos, porque sabemos que o nosso propósito final é comum: encantar nossos clientes!
Entregar do Jeito Certo significa agir com integridade e ética, enfrentando desafios de frente para garantir a melhor qualidade, experiência e valor em tudo o que fazemos.
Mas não queremos apenas atender expectativas, queremos Surpreender. Ir além do esperado e fazer tudo parecer mágica faz parte do nosso DNA.
Inovar está no nosso dia a dia. Para isso, estamos sempre dispostos a Questionar. Se existe uma forma melhor e mais eficiente, nós vamos atrás dela. Sempre com base em dados e com uma abordagem estruturada para propor mudanças que façam a diferença.
E, claro, também precisamos Curtir o caminho. Celebramos cada conquista – das pequenas até as grandes – com brilho nos olhos, aprendendo com os erros e criando espaço para aquilo que mais importa na vida.
Se você se identifica com essa forma de trabalhar e viver, então você encontrou o seu lugar.

title: Plant Manager
description:
Yara Industrial Solutions (YIS) is a global unit within Yara International. Our talented workforce of around 2,000 people in 28 countries and on all continents, capture, transform, and apply nitrogen to create a wide range of industrial products for an even wider range of industries. We continue to grow our knowledge about chemistry to support customers’ own processes and supply chains, making a difference to society every day.

As part of the YIS team, your unique contribution will be valued and acknowledged. We work hard to create an inclusive environment where our people can bring their true selves to work. In YIS you can be confident that your development is on the agenda from day one and that whatever your background you will have the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed.

About the business unit


Cubatão covers the entire operation of four manufacturing plants (CUB1, CUB2 and CUB3) from the handling of the raw material to the dispatch to customers. CUB 1 produces NA (53%,61% and 99%), LDAN, and AN solution 82%, CUB 2 produces Ammonia, NA (53% and 61%), HDAN, AN solution 82%, Sulphuric acid, PhosAcid, and MAP, and CUB3 produces Sulphuric acid, SSP powder and NPKs. The unit stretches across a significant area in Santos, Sao Paolo and is recognized as a responsible employer in the region.

About the Role

As Plant Manager you are passionate about achieving operational excellence and have a genuine interest in helping the company and your employees succeed. You will be responsible for steering the continuous improvement and optimization of all processes in the plant. You will lead a competent team, overseeing the production, maintenance, and safety of the unit to ensure compliance with company objectives, quality systems, and customer expectations.

You are a people-person, with excellent communication and collaboration skills, putting them to good use both inside Yara and with external stakeholders. You care about your assets, your employees, your company and your community. You are innovative and resourceful, and eager to contribute to the prosperity of people and planet.


The position reports to SVP HESQ and Production and is based in the region of Santos, Sao Paolo Brazil.

Responsibilities
• Develop a vision/strategy (road map) for present and future operations.
• Aim for excellence and continuous improvement in the overall site operation.
• Propose, defend, and implement the Business Plan for the coming year, managing the annual budget.
• Prioritize and ensure site adherence to legal regulations and to Yara internal HESQ policies.
• Establish site specific policies and procedures based on the framework set by the Yara Steering System.
• Meet annual volumes and fixed cost targets by ensuring reliable and systematic operations.
• Analyze the need for investments and propose projects in adherence to the Capital Value Process.
• Ensure excellent cooperation within the region on best practices and initiatives; to speed up the implementation and usage of such best practices and to achieve optimal synergies.
• Ensure good relationship with unions and/or employee representatives, creating a good climate for industrial relations, while encouraging a performance culture.
• Promote good social citizenship with external stakeholders such as regulatory bodies, authorities, media, local communities, etc.
• Secure workforce and succession planning, focusing on talents and critical positions; ensuring a proper organizational design.
• Lead and support the development of all direct reports, maximizing competencies and alignment to business demands. Ensuring employees have a clear vision of Yara´s performance culture and values.
• Embody a learning attitude, by remaining curious, and seeking out all relevant sources of information to excel in both technical and people related topics.
• Acknowledge, demonstrate, and encourage a good work/private life balance.

Profile

• University degree, preferably in a natural science or an engineering subject.
• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a complex site management, production management or project management in the (petro)chemical industry.
• Ability to create accountability and to lead by example
• Strong team building, decision-making and people management skills
• Hands-on mentality and good interpersonal skills.
• Willingness to travel when needed.
• Fluent in English and intermediate Portuguese.

We can offer

• Learning and development opportunities.
• Competitive terms and conditions.
• Inclusive company culture and a collaborative working environment.
• International, dynamic working environment in a truly global organization.
• Assurance that your contribution makes a difference.

We believe that creating a diverse and inclusive work environment is not only the right thing, but also the smart thing to do. To deliver on this, Yara has firmly anchored Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) in our business strategy and has more than 400 employees worldwide involved in DEI ambassador networks.

title: Trading Support Analyst
description:
Fidessa's Trading Support Analysts provide functional support for all customer requests across Fidessa's multi-asset product range. This opening has specific focus around the support and training of new and existing users of the Fidessa equities trading and risk management platform. This platform provides high-speed access to global equities exchanges and execution venues and is used by top tier brokers worldwide. Based in São Paulo this team is part of the Fidessa Global Service Desk and is formed of an enthusiastic mix of individuals with strong technical, functional and customer service skills, looking for a challenging and varied role in a fast paced environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with up to 4 years of experience who wants direct interaction with clients and trading floors, exposure to complex financial products and a career pathway in trade support, product management or technical account management.

Key Responsibilities:

  • In order to meet the requirements of the Customer base and the diverse needs of the evolving trading landscape, the Trading Support team caters to the immediate needs of our customers, resolving a high percentage of issues independently and liaising with specialist groups within the business and technology to ensure fast resolution of issues that require additional coordination to resolve.
  • In addition to providing real time phone, chat, and e-mail Support, Trading Support Analysts may be expected to conduct on-site customer visits within Mexico and South America to provide product training and support for Fidessa users. These visits provide valuable ground-level insight on how customers are using Fidessa services and can be leveraged to introduce solutions that will help improve customer workflows through new and existing Fidessa solutions.

Required Skills, Experience, and Qualifications:

  • At least 1 year of experience in equities trading operations, including basic knowledge of the equity markets and an understanding of equity business flows. Recent grads with significant internship experience in equities trading operations, equity markets and equity business lows will also be considered.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, demonstrating the ability to communicate succinctly and accurately to customers
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or engineering concentration (Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering) with a business focus OR Business-related degree with significant exposure to Information Systems, Computer Science or Computer Engineering
  • Self-motivated and positive attitude
  • Strong customer service ability
  • Excellent problem-solving skills
  • Ability to handle stressful situations in a trading environment
  • Proficiency in Spanish is a requirement

Desired Experience and Competencies:

  • Experience supporting Software as a Service platforms
  • Knowledge of financial software platforms
About Us

We’re a diverse group of visionary innovators who provide trading and workflow automation software, high-value analytics, and strategic consulting to corporations, central banks, financial institutions, and governments. Founded in 1999, we’ve achieved tremendous growth by bringing together some of the best and most successful financial technology companies in the world.

Over 2,000 of the world’s leading corporations, including 50% of the Fortune 500 and 30% of the world’s central banks, trust ION solutions to manage their cash, in-house banking, commodity supply chain, trading and risk.

title: [2025] Talent Pool B2C - XP Future | Campinas
description:
Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores
  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade
Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Campinas , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

O Que Procuramos
Pré-requisitos Essenciais
  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Ter disponibilidade para trabalhar em modelo híbrido em Campinas;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais
  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro).

Desafios e Impacto
  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
  • Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Etapas do Processo
  • Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.
  • Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.
  • Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.
  • Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.
  • Entrevista com Head Comercial: Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.
  • Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.
  • Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Benefícios Que Oferecemos
  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade
O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: 30/12/2024 - Presidente sanciona regra que limita aumento do salário mínimo; veja valor
description:
Presidente sanciona regra que limita aumento do salário mínimo; veja valor

O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva sancionou a lei que estabelece um limite para o reajuste do salário mínimo, restringindo-o a até 2,5% acima da inflação entre 2025 e 2030. A medida integra o pacote de controle de despesas obrigatórias proposto pelo governo federal e aprovado pelo Congresso há cerca de dez dias.

Com a nova regra, o salário mínimo para 2025 deverá ser de R$ 1.518, um acréscimo de R$ 106 em relação ao valor atual de R$ 1.412. O número ainda será oficializado por decreto presidencial, a ser publicado nos próximos dias.

A medida busca alinhar o reajuste do salário mínimo ao novo arcabouço fiscal. Assim, os aumentos anuais serão limitados a uma faixa de 0,6% a 2,5% acima da inflação.

A política de correção do mínimo vigente desde 2023 será mantida, calculando-se o reajuste com base na soma da inflação acumulada pelo Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor (INPC) até novembro e o crescimento do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) de dois anos anteriores. No entanto, o teto de 2,5% acima da inflação agora restringe a parcela adicional vinculada ao PIB.

Salário mínimo
A aprovação da lei no final do ano legislativo deverá gerar uma economia de R$ 15,3 bilhões nos próximos cinco anos. De acordo com a Lei de Diretrizes Orçamentárias, cada real de aumento no salário mínimo eleva os gastos federais em cerca de R$ 392 milhões, sobretudo devido à Previdência Social e a benefícios vinculados ao piso, como o Benefício de Prestação Continuada (BPC).


Sob as regras anteriores, o salário mínimo de 2025 seria de aproximadamente R$ 1.528, considerando a inflação acumulada de 4,84% e o crescimento do PIB de 3,2% em 2023. No entanto, com o teto imposto pela nova legislação, o reajuste foi ajustado para R$ 1.518.

O pagamento do novo salário mínimo começará no final de janeiro ou início de fevereiro de 2025, referente ao trabalho realizado no primeiro mês do ano.

At Nearsure, we know great talent doesn’t wait for job openings. That’s why we’re building a community of passionate professionals for future opportunities.

These proactive searches align with the profiles our trusted clients seek regularly. Join our "Future Talent" network to be among the first considered when the right opportunity arises.

As a DevOps Engineer (Red Hat OpenShift) , you will be part of a cross-functional team responsible for the complete software development life cycle, from conception to deployment. The role will involve collaborating with mobile developers to maintain and expand the backend as we continue to add and update features.

How your day-to-day work will look like:

  • Work in an agile environment to design, develop, test, and deploy software.
  • Collaborate with development teams and product managers.
  • Design client-side and server-side architecture.
  • Develop and manage databases and applications.
  • Design and build APIs.
  • Test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade software.
  • Write technical documentation.

This would make you the ideal candidate:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ Years of experience working with Python.
  • 3+ Years of experience working with APIs.
  • 3+ Years of experience working with AWS.
  • 1+ Years of experience working with Flask.
  • 1+ Years of experience working with Firebase or MongoDB.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

What to expect from our Talent Connection process:

  • Sign up: Apply to this position and upload your resume.
  • Profile review: Our team will review your profile and keep it in our talent database.
  • Contact: Our team will contact you to have an interview to get to know you better and to share with you a bit more of what we are looking for.
  • Knowing you better: We'd love to discuss your experience in an interview with our recruiters.
  • Notification: When a suitable position opens, we’ll contact you to start the selection process, having in mind that this process will be faster because we already had the first screening.
  • Transparency: This process is direct and without intermediaries.

At Nearsure, we’re dedicated to solving complex business challenges through cutting-edge technology and we believe in the power of tailored solutions. Whether you are passionate about transforming businesses with Generative AI, building innovative software products, or implementing comprehensive enterprise platform solutions, we invite you to be part of our dynamic team!

We would love to hear from you if you are eager to make an impact and join a collaborative team that values creativity and expertise.

Analista Sênior de Excelência Operacional - Mercado Envios

Join to apply for the Analista Sênior de Excelência Operacional - Mercado Envios role at Mercado Livre Brasil

No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

No Mercado Envios administramos o estoque de nossos vendedores e entregamos os produtos aos nossos compradores, melhorando sua experiência em nossa plataforma. Em um mundo em constante evolução, nossa capacidade para entregar rapidamente os produtos que são comprados através do Mercado Livre tornou-se um requisito para competir. Faça parte da equipe que está liderando a logística na América Latina, oferecendo soluções customizadas de classe mundial e integrando carriers locais e regionais, através de um comércio que não reconhece fronteiras.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, alegria e diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Focar no apoio a todas as implementações locais. Podendo ser implementações de novos processos, tecnologias, sistemas ou equipamentos.
  • Apoiar e ser co-responsável na implementação dos planos de ação criados pelo líder local da operação.
  • Estar presente na operação, gerando plano de ação e garantindo o cumprimento do mesmo no que tange aos projetos em implementação ou discoverys de iniciativas de melhoria da eficiência operacional.
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e alavancar KPIs estratégicos para o negócio.
  • Mapear as oportunidades de melhoria no país e conduzir discussões com o time corporativo e regional. Quando replicável, fazer implementação para as demais operações do país.
  • Conectar-se com todas as equipes regionais para validar as melhorias propostas e revisar o portfólio de iniciativas locais que impactam TI ou mudança de processo.

Requisitos:

  • Ter formação superior completa em Administração, Logística, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Possuir experiência na aplicação da metodologia MTM (Methods-Time Measurement) em processos logísticos;
  • Contar com conhecimento sobre os princípios e práticas da metodologia Lean e ter certificação Green Belt ou Black Belt em Lean Six Sigma;
  • Utilizar ferramentas da qualidade como PDCA, SDCA, Kaizen, Pareto, Histograma e Diagrama de Ishikawa;
  • Ter disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Cajamar/SP.

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

HDR is looking for an energetic, hard working problem solver to become a full time Senior Operations Specialist to work on both municipal and industrial water treatment facilities. If you are someone who is looking to work on a variety of treatment technologies for multiple treatment plants, then this position will be for you. This individual will work on water treatment projects that can range from small municipalities to some of the most iconic in the United States. Our engineering staff rely heavily upon our Operations Specialist staff to create solutions with better reliability and improved operability for our clients.
You will not only be a part of our East Region team, but will be a key member of HDR’s nationwide Operations Team. This team is made up of other experienced maintenance and operations experts, and coordinate to share best practices, experience, and opportunities to utilize every team member’s unique expertise. We currently have extensive project backlog in throughout the United States, so you will be able to immediately contribute to our success.
The work location will be at the HDR office closest to your current location. Please check the HDR website nearest to you.
About Us
For over 100 years, HDR has specialized in engineering, architecture, environmental and construction services. We provide solutions to thousands of partners, from small local utilities to the largest global companies. HDR has nearly 13,000 employee owners worldwide and ENR ranked in the top 10 of Water design firms, Water Treatment and Desalination design firms, and Wastewater design firms. Our Water Business Group has over 2,000 employee owners, with over 500 in our Eastern Region.
At HDR, we know work isn’t only about who you work for; it’s also about what you do and how you do it. Led by the strength of our values and a culture shaped by employee ownership, we network with each other, build on each other’s contributions, and collaborate together to make great things possible. When you join HDR, we give you license to do the same. We help you take charge of your career, giving you multiple growth opportunities along the way.
Primary Responsibilities

  • Support HDR project leaders at the local, state, and regional level on water treatment projects requiring input from Operations Specialists.
  • Review drawings for operability review and HazOps analysis with an eye for what it takes to successfully operate a variety of treatment processes successfully.
  • Manage operations and maintenance projects with both municipal and industrial clients. It will involve client interfacing, regulatory reporting, as well as personnel, subcontractor, and maintenance management.
  • Develop startup and commissioning plans and host workshops to share those ideas with client’s contractors and operators to ensure the plan will work for each specific plant.
  • Perform startup and commissioning of new water treatment facilities. This work involves you playing a key role in working alongside contractors and engineers to ensure the new equipment functions correctly before handing it over to the operations and maintenance staff.
  • Perform formal and informal training to help our clients’ treatment plants operate as well as they can operate.
  • Participate in the testing of facilities to ensure they are ready for startup and after startup they meet the capacity requirements of the design.
  • Perform condition assessment and asset management tasks on water and wastewater facilities, using state of the art evaluation tools to efficiently capture the information and opinions that you generate.
  • Perform operational or maintenance troubleshooting and evaluations on municipal and industrial water facilities.
Work will involve a base of projects in the southern portion of the central United States, but will also include projects in several sites across the country. It provides the opportunity to work on a variety of new and innovative projects, and provides a career path that has more growth than typical utility organizations.
This job may require 30 to 40% travel, more is possible. Weekend travel is normally not required.
Strongly Preferred Qualifications
  • Minimum 10 years field experience in troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation equipment at water treatment facilities and/or resolving water treatment process problems. Additional construction experience is a plus.
  • High level water treatment operator license or professional engineering license.
  • Ability to interpret engineering plans and specifications.
  • Microsoft Office product and computerized maintenance and management systems experience required.
  • An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must
  • Valid driver’s license.

  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • Microsoft Office product experience
  • General background-related experience
  • An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.
Our Commitment
As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.
Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. description:
Join to apply for the Regional Finance Director role at Videojet Technologies

Join to apply for the Regional Finance Director role at Videojet Technologies

  • Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impacton the world around you.
  • Thriving in a supportive team environmentthat inspires you to strive for excellence.
  • Collaborating with a vibrant, diverse, global team.

Imagine yourself…
  • Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impacton the world around you.
  • Thriving in a supportive team environmentthat inspires you to strive for excellence.
  • Collaborating with a vibrant, diverse, global team.

It’s all possible with a role at Videojet, a Veralto company. You have likely purchased or used a product touched by Videojet Technologies this week—after all, Videojet is a world leader in the product identification market, providing in-line printing, coding and marking products, consumables, and software solutions.
Videojet’s technologies play a critical role in ensuring the safety and authenticity of products sold across the globe in the food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and industrial marketplaces.
As part of the Videojet team and the broader Veralto network, you’ll work with products that make an everyday impact on the world around you—and along the way, you’ll have opportunities to make your mark on our business and your career with ongoing opportunities to deepen your skillset and pursue your ambitions.
We offer:
  • Flexible working hours
  • Professional onboarding and training options
  • Powerful team looking forward to working with you
  • Career coaching and development opportunities
  • Health benefits

Reporting to the Finance and Chief Financial Officer - Vice President, the Regional Finance Director is responsible for supporting the country business teams in the areas of budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, variance analyses, data modelling, and analytics to drive sustained profitable business growth for Videojet Latin America (plus Mexico). The Finance Director, will need to focus on the bigger picture and long-term results, and also ensure day-to-day execution of the right actions on time in a compliant manner with the help of his /her team and will be located in Sao Paulo or CDMX.
In this role, a typical day will look like:
  • Create and own the monthly, quarterly and annual forecasts for the Sales & Service Organizations.
  • Improve profitability and balance sheet through monthly analysis of revenue, cost and inventory variances. Use the analyses to lead initiatives for the business to improve Product mix, Pricing, Discounts, AP and AR.
  • Build and lead the team and processes for AR, AP, Invoicing, Credit and Taxation functions.
  • Controllership of existing and new agreements with distributors, strategic partners, vendors, and Global manufacturing plants. Consolidation and reporting of budget for all regions. Analyze spending trends and provide recommendations for cost optimization.
  • Provide advisory and consultative support to the team on all finance-related areas, including accounting policies and other compliance requirements.
  • Work closely with the Videojet Global , Product Quality & Innovation OpCo finance teams. Veralto Latin America to ensure upkeep of the highest financial integrity standards while conducting business. Ensure compliance requirements for all internal and external stakeholders

The essential requirements of the job include:
  • 10+ years of experience in finance-roles, with at least 5 years leading multi-national teams in a Commercial Finance role, working closely with Global and cross functional teams in a matrix environment.
  • Experience leading and inspiring teams fostering a collaborative and high performance culture
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft applications (Excel, Word and PowerPoint and working knowledge of financial planning systems such as Hyperion
  • Excellent knowledge of forecasting techniques
  • Strong accounting background, especially revenue/expense recognition rule with extensive experience in financial forecasting and modelling
  • Great data visualization and presentation skills to provide recommendations based on insight
  • Demonstrated proficiency in time and project management skills; ability to manage multiple projects across critical yet often fluctuating deadlines – and with sometimes minimal and/or ambiguous input from stakeholders.
  • Up to 25% travel required

Preferred skills:
  • Chartered Certified

Videojet is proud to part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto’s vibrant global network of 16,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources—and building rewarding careers along the way.
At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.
If you’ve ever wondered what’s within you, there’s no better time to find out.

Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.
At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.
Estamos procurando uma pessoa com forte expertise para atuar como Liderança Regional de Talent Acquisition (TA) para a América Latina, integrando nosso time global de liderança de Recrutamento e Seleção / Talent Acquisition.
Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica para desenvolver e implementar a abordagem de TA na região LATAM, em alinhamento com a estratégia global, dentro de uma organização com estrutura matricial internacional.
A posição lidera uma equipe responsável pelos processos de recrutamento em vários países (Argentina, Brasil, Colômbia, México e Peru), com contribuição direta para os objetivos globais de atração e seleção de talentos.
Somos uma agência global de comunicação, responsável por construir, promover e proteger marcas e reputações de vários clientes. Entregamos trabalhos de qualidade, enquanto colaborando com uma rede de profissionais dedicados, em um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e focado em desenvolver o que há de melhor em cada um!
Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento de Estratégia: Desenvolver e implementar uma estratégia abrangente de aquisição de talentos para a região LATAM, alinhada ao modelo global de talent acquisition. Essa estratégia deve incluir melhores práticas, inovação, iniciativas de DEI (Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão) e planejamento de força de trabalho.
  • Recrutamento Executivo: Conduzir processos completos de recrutamento de cargos de liderança sênior na região LATAM, com foco em identificar, atrair e construir relacionamentos de longo prazo com talentos-chave.
  • Gestão de Mudanças: Liderar iniciativas de gestão de mudanças para se adaptar às condições de mercado, novas tecnologias e tendências do setor. Implementar soluções inovadoras para aprimorar a experiência e a eficiência do processo de recrutamento.
  • Transformação: Liderar e apoiar esforços de transformação na área de talent acquisition, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais. Impulsionar melhorias contínuas em processos, ferramentas e metodologias.
  • Abordagem Baseada em Dados: Utilizar dados e análises para embasar decisões, acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho e identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de atração de talentos.
  • Engajamento com Stakeholders: Colaborar com stakeholders regionais e globais para entender as necessidades de talentos e garantir uma experiência fluida e positiva para candidatos e gestores de contratação.
  • Especialização em Marca Empregadora: Conduzir com sucesso ações de fortalecimento da marca empregadora na região LATAM. Desenvolver e executar estratégias para posicionar a organização como empregadora de escolha, mantendo uma imagem forte e consistente em diferentes países.
  • Gestão de Equipe Regional: Liderar e orientar uma equipe geograficamente distribuída, demonstrando sensibilidade às dinâmicas culturais locais. Promover colaboração, oferecer suporte e garantir o cumprimento das metas de recrutamento.

Requisitos:
  • Graduação completa em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em Talent Acquisition - profissional precisa ter o perfil especialista e não generalista;
  • Experiência em liderança de equipes multiculturais e distribuídas geograficamente.
  • Vivência anterior em ambientes globais.
  • Histórico de condução de recrutamento executivo (C-level e diretoria), porém também fará posições de todos os outros níveis.
  • Atuação com transformação de processos, change management e employer branding.
  • Inglês fluente (obrigatório) – uso constante em reportes e alinhamentos globais.
  • Espanhol fluente (obrigatório) – considerando a atuação na região.
